title: Tote state inconsistency triage
playbook_goal: Route from an operator-reported tote state discrepancy to the correct backend verification and, if needed, escalation.

nodes.title: Verify tote state against backend task history
nodes.intent: Confirm whether the discrepancy is a display lag or a genuine backend state mismatch.

branches.condition: Backend task history matches the operator screen.
Backend task history does not match, or no history rows exist.

nodes.title: Escalate unresolved tote state mismatch
nodes.intent: Hand off to L3 when the backend record itself is inconsistent.
nodes.stop_or_escalation_note: Escalate to L3 support with the ToteTaskHistory query results attached.
